body: Use exact raw tokens rather than numerical reserialization. Generate alternative column-major NUL streams and position-major byte planes with counted token lengths. Store line endings, dimensions and the chosen mode in the payload; retain a tagged ordinary-zstd fallback for unsupported layouts. Bounds-check before allocating from decoded dimensions.

Measure each alternative after compression at comparable backend effort. The Stage 3 training probes used 7,447 bytes for plain transpose at zstd-9 versus 6,591 at zstd-19, so a layout comparison with different levels can hide the representation effect. The encoder budget is 30 seconds per bounded block; the frozen acceptance speed gate applies to decode.

The [generated adaptive source](../../../plugins/stage3-byteplanes-r1/codec.rs), SHA-256 `3d0f93fed0f457b33097f605c80dd314fbdb6c87bc2312fc4fca5acb9e3a499c`, selected NUL-column tag 1 on validation-000/006 and byte-plane tag 2 on validation-013. Its complete collection used 40,108 bytes versus xz 46,253 and the structured reference 40,434. These are three development probes, not unseen-data evidence.

For refinement, compare column-only, plane-only and adaptive variants while keeping the backend/metadata policy controlled. Per-block mode selection proves that an alternative was exercised; only those ablations can establish its causal saving. Record regressions as well as wins, preserve parents and source hashes, and use the fresh frozen evaluator process for official scores.

Stage 4 supplied the causal check: at level 19, column-only uses 40,506 bytes and adaptive 40,108, so plane support saves 398 bytes on the third probe. Keep backend effort, decoder, framing and method-name length fixed. The evolved per-column mixture at level 22 uses 37,130 bytes; disabling only its mixed-choice condition gives 40,051, a 2,921-byte contribution. Prefer per-column alternatives only after accounting for modes, lengths and their final global compressed size; keep the parent whole-block fallbacks.

The [frozen mixed-column source](../../../artifacts/stage4-selected/codec.rs), SHA-256 `98e12bcd61e8117b0c9f3cc6b4edfbc3ebcb13f11d332c39290903ed97cc8cf7`, is selected for one later sealed verification. Equal archive sizes prefer a smaller decoder package; dictionary/template descendants added code without improving these probe sizes. Do not reopen search or replace the frozen source after viewing sealed results.

Keep deployment claims separate: Stage 3's 383,192-byte executable and Stage 4's selected 391,032-byte executable both erase archive savings on this small corpus. The Stage 4 package saving is −381,909 bytes. Scientific novelty and an unseen-data win remain unestablished.

Evidence: [training representations](../../../reports/stage3/representation-probes.json), [candidate validation](../../../reports/stage3/candidates/stage3-byteplanes-r1/evaluation.json), and [versioned observations](../../../reports/stage3/observations.jsonl). Reproduce with `python -m algomini.evaluator evaluate stage3-byteplanes-r1 --split validation`.

Stage 4 evidence: [fixed-level ablations](../../../reports/stage4/ablations.json), [mixed-choice removal](../../../reports/stage4/mixed-choice-ablation.json), and [active candidate freeze](../../../repro/candidate-freeze.json). Verify with `python -m algomini selected-status --build`.

Start with `python -m algomini research-profile`. It reads bounded training probes and records byte offsets, raw-token equality, prefixes and numeric lexical classes. Read the [measured profile](../../../reports/stage3/profile-train.json) before proposing a transform.

Keep the raw bytes as the reconstruction authority. This workload has double-quoted numbers, leading spaces, scientific notation and long decimal expansions. Decimal statistics unwrap these for analysis only. Store all spelling/style information or use a reversible exception path; numerical closeness does not permit rounding. Preserve CRLF and final-newline state.

When checking repeated columns, compare data records and preserve the header separately. The sampled `rv1`/`rv2` values match, but their names differ. A generic codec must detect the relationship in each block and retain exceptions rather than assume it from a field name.

Use token offsets from `.cache/lab/layout/<input-sha256>.json` to recover counterexamples from the original development file. The index is derived; the versioned profile retains input hashes and first-record offsets. The probe uses raw comma boundaries and is not a general quoted-CSV parser. Unsupported layouts need a reversible fallback.

Measure the complete encoded representation after zstd, including lengths, predictor choices, exceptions and shared models. Prefix-byte savings and estimated numeric residual bits are hypotheses, not archive gains. Compare with the frozen raw-token transpose reference before expanding a family.

Evidence: [training profile](../../../reports/stage3/profile-train.json), [first layout source](../../../plugins/stage3-column-layout/codec.rs), and its [validation result](../../../reports/stage3/candidates/stage3-column-layout/evaluation.json). The header/level explanations for that regression are source-based hypotheses pending ablation.

Use `python -m algomini lab list` to discover the available probes. Run `byte-structure` before interpreting text, then `text-repetition`; use `json-lexemes` for complete JSON or JSONL samples. A bounded XML/JSON fragment need not parse as a complete document. Keep that limitation in the report rather than repairing or normalizing the sample.

Repeated words and schemas suggest dictionary, prefix or template experiments. Their occurrence counts do not establish a compression improvement: test the representation with literal tables, IDs, lengths and exceptions included. Preserve original whitespace, numeric spelling, entity escaping, key order and duplicate keys.

Treat tools as research capabilities and this skill as an investigation procedure. Keep probe versions, input hashes and negative findings with each campaign. Reuse a measured mechanism only after checking its applicability to the new workload. The final codec may use a reversible fallback when a text-specific transform is unsupported.
